note: Every place two sources about this machine part, what each says, which one this package follows and why, and what would close it.
authority: The rungs are the ones hardware.json names, in its order.

divergences.topic: What RAM C000h holds when the export BIOS starts a cartridge.

referenceSays.claim: C000h holds A8h, and the census boards of sms-mapper-python and sega-vdp-python start every Master System run from it.
referenceSays.source: sms-mapper-python conformance/harness.py and sega-vdp-python's census board, at v1.0.0 and v1.0.1

recordingSays.claim: C000h holds ABh, the port 3E value the BIOS has just written to turn the cartridge on.
recordingSays.source: BIOS 1.3 and BIOS 2.0 run on this package with Sonic The Hedgehog, read at the instruction at 0000h

thisPackageDid.claim: Starts every Master System census run with SP DFF0h and C000h ABh.
thisPackageDid.why: Both original BIOS images leave ABh there, and A8h is a value no BIOS was seen to write. Bits 0 and 1 of port 3E select nothing, so a cartridge that masks them reads the two alike.

divergences.wouldCloseIt: On a Master System with each BIOS, start a cartridge that shows the byte at C000h on screen.
